tables.title: [Pre-campaign receipts and disbursements of the major parties, 1 January to 10 March 1946]
tables.source_note: Reported under Home Ministry Ordinance No. 11 (paragraph 16, printed page 31)
tables.ocr_check: OCR misread most figures (e.g. Progressives receipts 859,328 for 839,322, Liberals 621,846 for 821,646, Communists 297,343 for 597,543) and read the yen sign as $; the image reading was used. Notes: the yen sign appears only on the first row in the original.
